name: EC2DescribeInstances
description: This function interfaces with the EC2 service to retrieve detailed information about specified EC2 instances. It supports custom filtering, specific instance IDs, regional targeting, and legacy mode handling.
syntax: EC2DescribeInstances( [string accessKeyId], [string secretAccessKey], [array instanceIds], [struct filters], [string host], [string location], [number timeout] )

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Your AWS access key ID. Used for authentication with AWS services. This key must have appropriate permissions for EC2 describe instance operations.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: Your AWS secret access key associated with the access key ID. This key is used in conjunction with the accessKeyId for authentication.

params.name: instanceIds
params.description: An array of instance IDs specifying the EC2 instances to describe. If not provided, information for all instances will be returned.

params.name: filters
params.description: A struct of filters to apply to the instance description request. Each key in the struct is a filter name, and its value is an array of filter values.

params.name: host
params.description: The endpoint or the provider to connect to. If not set, Amazon AWS is used. This can be used to specify a different AWS region or a custom EC2-compatible endpoint.

params.name: location
params.description: The AWS region hosting the EC2 endpoint. If not specified, the default region associated with the provided credentials is used.

params.name: timeout
params.description: The timeout in milliseconds for the EC2 describe instances request. Defaults to 10000 milliseconds (10 seconds).
